title: Sony BRAVIA KD-43X80L (2023, model string "BRAVIA 4K VH22", product BRAVIA_VH22_M_EU, device BRAVIA_VH22, MediaTek MT5895), EU
header:
Sony BRAVIA KD-43X80L (2023, model string "BRAVIA 4K VH22", product BRAVIA_VH22_M_EU, device BRAVIA_VH22, MediaTek MT5895), EU
Android 12 (Google TV, API 31), build BRAVIA_VH22_M_EU-user 12 STT2.230505.001.S136 682241 release-keys

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/sony-kd-43x80l/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/sony-kd-43x80l/debloat.txt com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Stock launcher: com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx (Google TV). Pass it to restore.sh as above.
Live TV / tuner app: com.sony.dtv.tvx (set it as live_tv_package in the launcher's config.xml and hide it).
Keep the com.sony.dtv.tvinput.* services, com.sony.dtv.braviasync*, com.sony.dtv.tvapi,
com.sony.dtv.sonysystemservice, settingsprovider, systemupdate/update (firmware), the Sony
settings apps and all com.mediatek.*: they drive HDMI, the tuner, Bravia Sync, updates and the remote.
Already disabled at the factory: com.sony.dtv.my5launcher, de.hdplus.tvapp.androidtv,
com.sony.dtv.soundslauncher, com.apple.atve.sony.appletv, com.sony.dtv.b2b.vendorprotocol,
com.youview.poa, com.sony.dtv.iplayerlauncher, com.sony.dtv.itvlauncher, com.sony.dtv.ardlauncher,
com.sony.dtv.b2b.softap, com.sony.dtv.all4launcher.

Tested and lived with on a KD-43X80L running the clean Apple TV style launcher (com.gathin.tvhome).
setupwraith disabled safely (Wi-Fi network owned by com.android.tv.settings, no reconnection issues).
Disabling setupwraith gives Home back but can break casting (Chromecast built-in); comment out its line
below if you want to keep casting.
HDMI inputs (1-4, eARC), tuner TVX, remote control, and network streaming apps (Max, VLC, TIMVISION,
RaiPlay) verified working across reboots.

apps.note: Samba TV fingerprints what is on screen (ACR)
Sony Select app store / promo tile
Sony tab on Google TV home

Hotel / professional B2B mode (unused in a home)
Voice assistant (removes remote mic search; comment out these three to keep it)
